title: The Locked Gallery
subtitle: Curator Elias Vorn discovered dead in a secured exhibition chamber.

briefing.summary: At 22:15, gallery curator Elias Vorn was found deceased inside the climate-controlled Old Masters vault. The electronic bolt was secured from the inside, but ventilation seals had been disabled.
briefing.objective: Identify the culprit who entered after closing, broke their alibi, and staged the sealed vault.
requiredSolveConditions: Establish physical means and service door entry

suspects.name: Mara Voss
suspects.relationshipToVictim: Direct subordinate, prospective heir to gallery directorship
suspects.profile: Expert art restorer with detailed knowledge of museum chemical solvents and electronic security locks.
suspects.initialAlibi: Claims she left the gallery before the evening downpour at 8:00 PM and took the metro home.

interrogationTopics.questionText: When exactly did you leave the museum?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: As I said in my initial statement, I left right around 7:55 PM. The pavement was completely dry.

interrogationTopics.questionText: What chemicals do you use in restoration?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: Standard non-reactive varnishes and xylene compounds for oil varnish removal. All locked in my studio under bio-metric key.

interrogationTopics.questionText: Did Elias confront you about provenance audits?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: Elias was paranoid about every auction item. He questioned everyone, not just me.

confrontations.defenseReaction: A weather report doesn't change when I stepped through the door.
confrontations.brokenReaction: ...Fine. The rain started at 8:11, yes. But my badge was scanned later because the front turnstile jammed!
confrontations.newFactUnlocked: Mara admits presence in the gallery lobby after 8:11 PM.

confrontations.defenseReaction: I left my spare umbrella in the locker. What does that prove?
confrontations.brokenReaction: You think I walked out into an 18mm/hour downpour without an umbrella? ...Damn you.
confrontations.newFactUnlocked: Mara's staged front-exit alibi completely collapses.

confrontations.defenseReaction: Solvent evaporates. Inventory logs are updated weekly.
confrontations.brokenReaction: 2.5 liters doesn't evaporate in an afternoon... Elias told me he was going to the federal board tomorrow morning. He was going to destroy everything I built!
confrontations.newFactUnlocked: Mara Voss confesses to incapacitating Elias with xylene solvent.

suspects.name: Theo Grant
suspects.relationshipToVictim: Disputed buyer for the Holbein painting
suspects.profile: High-net-worth investor rumored to be facing financial freeze due to forged provenance inquiries.
suspects.initialAlibi: Remained at the North Pier Yacht Club bar from 8:00 PM to midnight.
knownFacts: Argued loudly with Elias over provenance at 7:30 PM

interrogationTopics.questionText: What were you arguing with Elias about at 7:30?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: The Holbein was genuine. Elias was getting cold feet because of some anonymous provenance rumor. I told him he was being foolish.

interrogationTopics.questionText: Can anyone vouch for you at the Yacht Club?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: Check my credit card tab. I was sitting at the waterfront bar from eight till past midnight with half the harbor committee.

confrontations.defenseReaction: See? That receipt verifies every drink from 19:55 onward.
confrontations.brokenReaction: That receipt is airtight, Detective. I was nowhere near that vault when Elias died.
confrontations.newFactUnlocked: Theo Grant's alibi is corroborated by timestamps and witnesses.

suspects.name: Lin Park
suspects.profile: Installed the new digital access control system two weeks prior to the incident.
suspects.initialAlibi: Monitoring server racks in central district dispatch during incident.

interrogationTopics.questionText: How secure is the digital vault lock?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: Triple-redundant biometric and RFID. Unless someone used an emergency engineer bypass badge, that door seals hermetically.

interrogationTopics.questionText: Where were you between 8:00 and 9:00 PM?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: Central dispatch monitoring rack telemetry. I have server log logins recorded by the district telecom.

confrontations.defenseReaction: That badge was issued to me, but I didn't scan it! Someone took my duplicate from the server room drawer!
confrontations.brokenReaction: Look at the badge serial: #ENG-88. I reported that duplicate missing three days ago! Someone in the museum stole it.
confrontations.newFactUnlocked: Lin Park confirms emergency badge #ENG-88 was stolen prior to the murder.

evidence.title: Coroner Report: Elias Vorn
evidence.summary: Death caused by acute inhalation of volatile industrial solvent between 20:15 and 20:45.
evidence.fullText: Coroner autopsy indicates asphyxiation due to concentrated isopropanol-xylene vapor compound. The victim exhibited no defensive wounds, indicating incapacitation occurred rapidly within an enclosed space.

evidence.title: Meteorological Telemetry: Bay District
evidence.summary: Severe torrential downpour commenced at North Pier at precisely 20:11.
evidence.fullText: National Weather Service coastal radar records zero precipitation between 18:00 and 20:10. At precisely 20:11, heavy thunderstorm activity recorded 18mm/hr precipitation across North Pier.

evidence.title: Main Entrance Door Sensor Log
evidence.summary: Badge 'M-VOSS' registered exit through front revolving door at 20:24.
evidence.fullText: Electronic audit trail at Main Entrance Port A: 20:24:18 - RFID badge 'M-VOSS' scanned outbound. No further reads registered at front portals until police arrival.

evidence.title: Mara Voss Witness Statement
evidence.summary: Mara claims she walked out into dry evening air before 8:00 PM without needing an umbrella.
evidence.fullText: "Elias asked me to leave early so he could confer privately with a buyer. I clocked out and walked to the metro before the rain started, around 7:55 PM. My coat and umbrella never even got wet."

evidence.title: Personal Umbrella in Staff Locker 04
evidence.summary: Mara's folding umbrella found completely dry and bone-dry canopy in staff locker.
evidence.fullText: Forensic sweep of staff lockers located personal umbrella belonging to Mara Voss. Fabric shows 0% residual moisture under ultraviolet inspection.

evidence.title: Yacht Club Tab: Theo Grant
evidence.summary: Continuous bar purchases by Theo Grant from 19:55 to 23:30 corroborated by bartender.
evidence.fullText: Point-of-Sale terminal records at North Pier Yacht Club show orders opened by Theo Grant at 19:55 and settled at 23:30 with continuous beverage updates. Bartender confirms physical presence.

evidence.title: Conservation Chemical Dispensary Log
evidence.summary: 2.5 Liters of Xylene-Isopropanol solvent unaccounted for in conservation lab.
evidence.fullText: Inventory audit of the restoration studio shows container X-404 missing 2.5L of volatile solvent. Access to this cabinet requires bio-metric clearance assigned only to Senior Restorer Mara Voss.

evidence.title: Rear Service Loading Door Override Audit
evidence.summary: Rear dock door unlocked via Lin Park's emergency badge at 20:31 from inside corridor.
evidence.fullText: Sub-level loading bay audit: Emergency bypass badge #ENG-88 registered an exit at 20:31:12. Contractor Lin Park was verified offsite, indicating badge was misappropriated.

evidence.title: Mara Voss Desk Drawer Search
evidence.summary: Lin Park's duplicate emergency badge found hidden in Mara's desk organizer.
evidence.fullText: Crime scene technicians recovered emergency bypass badge #ENG-88 concealed beneath felt lining in Mara Voss's private desk drawer.

evidence.title: Elias Vorn Private Memo: Provenance Fraud
evidence.summary: Elias discovered Mara had authenticated three forged Dutch master paintings for personal kickbacks.
evidence.fullText: "To the Board of Trustees: I have confirmed that Assistant Curator Mara Voss falsified spectral analysis reports for the Van Dyck and Holbein acquisitions. I am notifying the Federal Antiquities Division tomorrow morning at 09:00."

timeline.eventDescription: Elias documents Mara's forgery and schedules disclosure.

timeline.eventDescription: Theo establishes verified alibi at waterfront bar.

timeline.eventDescription: Coastal downpour starts across North Pier at 20:11.

timeline.eventDescription: Mara scans badge out front door after rain started.

timeline.title: Service dock emergency exit
timeline.eventDescription: Perpetrator flees via rear service door using stolen override badge.

timeline.title: Mara's claimed dry departure
timeline.eventDescription: Mara claims departure before rain in dry air.

contradictions.title: Rainfall vs Departure Sensor Discrepancy
contradictions.explanation: Mara claimed she left before the rain began at 7:55 PM, but the electronic door sensor logged her exit at 8:24 PM—thirteen minutes after torrential rainfall started.

contradictions.title: Dry Umbrella Contradiction
contradictions.explanation: If Mara exited at 20:24 during torrential rain, her umbrella in the staff locker would not be bone-dry, proving she staged her front-door exit and re-entered.

contradictions.title: Solvent Inventory Matches Fatal Chemical
contradictions.explanation: The coroner's fatal xylene compound matches the exact 2.5L volume missing from Mara's private conservation lab locker.

solution.resolutionNarrative: Faced with career ruin over forged provenance authentication, Mara Voss released toxic conservation solvent inside the vault, badged out the front to manufacture a fake alibi, and escaped out the service door using Lin Park's stolen bypass badge.

hints.text: Compare the weather radar precipitation timing against the main entrance door logs.
Mara claims she walked home in dry air, but radar records heavy rain before her badge was scanned.
Mara's alibi is shattered: she logged out at 20:24 in heavy rain while her umbrella remained dry, and used the rear service door to flee.
